# Akko League VII

A player's rating is his best of: dribbling, goalkeeping, finishing, low pass, lofted pass, heading, swerve, catching, body control, kicking power, explosive power, ball control, ball winning, jump, place kicking, stamina, speed, tenacity.
May sit below their target: attacking prowess, defensive prowess, injury resistance, weak foot usage, weak foot accuracy.

## Tiers
- **Gold**: 2 per team; every stat 99; form 8, injury resistance 8, weak foot 2/4; 6 paid cards, 2 free COM styles, 3 free tricks; 1 A position.
- **Silver**: 2 per team; every stat 92; form 8, injury resistance 8, weak foot 2/4; 5 paid cards, 1 free COM style, 3 free tricks; 1 A position.
- **Bronze**: 1 per team; every stat 85; form 8, injury resistance 8, weak foot 2/4; 4 paid cards, 1 free COM style, 2 free tricks; 1 A position.
- **Goalkeeper**: counts as Regular, registered GK; every stat 77; form 4, injury resistance 1, weak foot 2/2; 2 paid cards; 1 A position.
- **Regular**: the rest of the squad; every stat 77; form 4, injury resistance 1, weak foot 2/2; 3 paid cards, 2 free tricks; 1 A position.

## Heights
Brackets: Manlet up to 175, Mid 180, Tall 185, Giant 194 cm.
- **Green** (when any player is 194 cm or more): 6 manlet, 5 mid, 6 tall, 6 giant.
- **Red** (otherwise): 6 manlet, 7 mid, 10 tall, 0 giant.

## Every team
Every player is rated A at his registered position; no B ratings; GK is never a second A; a captain; at least 1 goalkeeper; at most 10 skill cards.

## Card groups
- **Tricks**: Scissors Feint, Flip Flap, Marseille Turn, Sombrero, Cut Behind & Turn.

## Special rules
- **The captain's Captaincy card is free**: The captain: Captaincy free.
- **Medals cannot be goalkeepers**: Gold, Silver or Bronze, registered GK: not allowed ("Medals cannot play as GK").
- **Goalkeepers at 189 count as tall**: Registered GK, 189 cm: count 4 cm shorter.
- **Tall goalkeepers are 189**: Registered GK, 181 to 188 cm: not allowed ("GKs in this bracket must be 189cm").
- **Goalkeepers below giant**: Registered GK, 194 cm or more: not allowed ("GK heights cannot be 194cm or more").
- **Manlets are 155 or taller**: 154 cm or less: not allowed ("Heights cannot be below 155cm").
- **Manlets**: Manlets: +1 paid card, +1 A position, weak foot 4/4.
- **Red manlet bonus**: Regular or Goalkeeper, under Red, 175 cm or less: may get +3 to every stat.
- **Green gold giants**: Gold, 194 cm or more: -4 to every stat.
- **Green silver giants**: Silver, 194 cm or more: -2 to every stat.

## Suggestions
Allowances not used up, listed as suggestions: paid cards, free tricks, free COM styles, weak foot, injury resistance and choices not taken.
